summary: Backend-only testing of new flight (outbound/return airline + confirmation + cost) and car (pickup/dropoff date+time+location) fields plus the updated travel CSV template/import flow. Created /app/backend/tests/test_travel_flight_car_fields.py with 12 pytest cases. Initial run: 11/12 PASS, 1 FAIL — /api/import/commit kind='travel' was dropping every new field (pickup_at, pickup_location, dropoff_at, dropoff_location, outbound_cost, return_airline, return_confirmation, return_cost, depart/arrive airport fields). Fixed by extending the Booking() constructor inside import_commit travel branch in /app/backend/server.py to pass through all new fields. Re-ran: 12/12 PASS.
action_items: Optional: extend /api/import/preview travel mapping to also surface outbound depart_airport/arrive_airport + return_depart_airport/return_arrive_airport columns. Right now parse_travel does not collect airport-code columns even though Booking has the fields and import_commit now persists them (the fix made the commit forward-compatible).
Optional refactor: server.py is now 2389 lines (over the 700-line guideline). The /import/* block (~290 lines) could split cleanly into routers/import.py.
critical_code_review_comments: RCA — bug found & fixed: import_commit's `travel` branch (server.py lines 1783-1803) constructed Booking() with an explicit subset of fields, so any new Booking field had to be manually added there. The latest change added pickup_at/pickup_location/dropoff_at/dropoff_location/outbound_cost/return_airline/return_confirmation/return_cost to the Booking model AND to parse_travel, but the commit step still used the old field list — so import preview surfaced the values but commit silently dropped them. A safer pattern would be to construct Booking via **{k: v for k,v in b.items() if k in Booking.model_fields} (or use BookingCreate.model_validate(b)) to avoid future regressions when new fields are added.
POST /api/bookings flight branch correctly auto-computes `cost = outbound_cost + return_cost` only when `cost` is missing/zero — explicit `cost: 999.99` is preserved (verified).
PATCH /api/bookings flight branch correctly recomputes `cost` when only one leg changes, using the persisted other-leg value (verified for both outbound-only and return-only PATCH).

Nullable set on PATCH /api/bookings now includes pickup_at/pickup_location/dropoff_at/dropoff_location and outbound_cost/return_airline/return_confirmation/return_cost — explicit null clears them (verified).

Travel CSV template now includes all required new headers: Pickup Date, Pickup Time, Pickup Location, Dropoff Date, Dropoff Time, Dropoff Location, Outbound Cost, Return Airline, Return Confirmation, Return Cost — while keeping legacy Flight Cost / Airline columns for back-compat (verified).
import_helpers._combine_dt correctly builds 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm' from separate Date + Time columns (verified: '2025-11-13' + '12:30 PM' -> '2025-11-13 12:30').
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (import_commit travel branch — pass-through for new car/flight fields)
seed_data_creation: Module-scoped fixture signs up a fresh TEST_travelnew_<uuid>@mailinator.com user and creates one TEST_Comp_<uuid> competition. All bookings created under this disposable account; no shared seed touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Travel/booking new-fields flow (flight outbound+return airline/confirmation/cost + car pickup/dropoff date+time+location) is fully green end-to-end (POST/PATCH bookings + GET template + import preview + import commit + GET /api/bookings persistence). Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_travel_flight_car_fields.py. Note: parse_travel does NOT yet emit airport-code columns (depart_airport/return_arrive_airport etc.); only times. If those columns get added to the template, parse_travel + TRAVEL_HEADERS need extending too — import_commit will already persist them once parse_travel surfaces them.
rca_of_issue: Bug reproduced via test_commit_persists_new_car_and_flight_fields: POST /api/import/commit kind=travel returned created=2 but the resulting car booking had pickup_at=None / pickup_location=None / dropoff_at=None / dropoff_location=None, and the flight booking had outbound_cost=None / return_airline=None / return_confirmation=None / return_cost=None. Root cause: server.py import_commit travel branch hand-listed 16 Booking fields when constructing Booking(...), omitting the 12 newly-added fields. Mitigation applied: added the missing fields to the constructor (pickup_at, pickup_location, dropoff_at, dropoff_location, depart_airport, arrive_airport, outbound_cost, return_airline, return_confirmation, return_depart_airport, return_arrive_airport, return_cost). Re-ran the full file — 12/12 PASS.
